purpose: Prevent a small or confounded model sample from triggering arbitrary difficulty inflation.

permitted_actions: record structural risks without tuning to them
select an error hypothesis for Pilot20
sentinel5.reason: Five observations per level have 20-point exact-score resolution and cannot support item tuning.

too_easy.action: Apply only the parent-registry mechanism linked to correctly answered eligible items.

weak_adjacent_transition.action: Modify only the upper level and only after the same error mechanism recurs across at least two anchors.

floor_effect.action: Do not add difficulty; diagnose protocol or reduce one burden in L1/L2.

forbidden_triggers: invalid, truncated or repaired provider output
a free or small model score used as a strong-model substitute

shadow_candidate_budget.first_external_test: five matched anchor-level cells affected by the proposed mechanism

required_shadow_gates: fresh zero-request cost and output-capacity preflight
